experiment: exp66 the protocol on DFC2020: eight-class land cover, both sensors, our own encoder, two references

references.dfc: the contest's 10 m reference, an iterated GEE random forest, published OA 0.824
references.lc: the 500 m MODIS labels remapped by the contest's IGBP2DFC

caveats: Sentinel-2 is L1C top-of-atmosphere; the encoder's modality is L2A surface reflectance
the split zips carry no real georeferencing; windows are addressed by patch and pixel
validation and test differ in class composition; this is a shift, not an i.i.d. split
publishing a DFC2020 number needs IEEE GRSS IADF and TUM approval under the contest terms
config.prereg: P1 the margin beats the NDWI control against the 10 m reference on every arm; P2 the sensor difference exceeds ten times the probe-seed floor and is boundary-enriched above 2x; P3 the boundary-first order's lead over the margin is larger against the 500 m reference than against the 10 m one
